sources.name: Unicode Standard Annex #9: Unicode Bidirectional Algorithm

provenance.notes: Written in this phase from the cited references and re-expressed; the Arabic text is the researcher's own wording and needs a native reviewer. The checks are proposals for the harness, not yet run.

title.ar: اللصق يُنظَّف بحسب نوع الحقل ولا يُسقط حروفًا
title.en: Paste is cleaned according to the field type and never drops letters

statement.ar: عند اللصق: في الحقول المنظمة تُزال محارف التحكم بالاتجاه والمسافات المحيطة وتُحوَّل الأرقام ثم يُتحقق من الباقي كما هو؛ في النص الحر يُحفظ ما لُصق كاملًا. لا يُقتطع النص الملصوق بصمت عند حد الطول.
statement.en: On paste: in structured fields bidi controls and surrounding whitespace are removed, digits are converted, and the rest is validated as it stands; in free text what was pasted is kept whole. Pasted text is never silently cut at a length limit.

rationale.ar: أغلب الأرقام والرموز تُدخل لصقًا، ومعها ما لا يُرى. والاقتطاع الصامت يحفظ رقم حساب ناقصًا يبدو سليمًا.
rationale.en: Most numbers and codes are entered by paste, along with what cannot be seen. Silent truncation stores an incomplete account number that looks fine.

checks: Pasting amounts AM-070…AM-074 gives the expected value; pasting phone-inputs PI-013…PI-015 gives the expected E.164.
Pasting a string longer than maxlength shows an error or the full text marked invalid; the field value is never a silent prefix.
Pasting a full code into the first cell of a segmented input distributes it across the cells.
Pasting into a free-text field leaves the code points unchanged.
